description: Five monks in grey-white habits and dark scapulars work in a marshy, reed-filled wetland under a stormy sky. One in the foreground cuts reeds with a scythe-like tool, another carries a long timber, and others carry bundles of cut reed or raise a post. Behind them is a half-built timber-framed roof structure among bare trees. The painting fills the frame with no visible text, border or wall.
